title: [CON2-6] Who receives admission key registrations: "every IO", "relays", or the agreement types mar
description: Review finding CON2-6: Who receives admission key registrations: "every IO", "relays", or the agreement types marked Yes? (lens CON2). Location: ARCHITECTURE.md:199-203, :221-225; spec/05-messaging.md:254; spec/10-relays.md:777; spec/03-spaces.md:354. Fix: §10.5.1 table marks `turn` and `push-proxy` "No"; ARCHITECTURE §6.1 ("every IO, of any service type"), §6.2 ("every IO that holds a `ServiceAgreement`") and 05 §5.2.2 ("every relay and other IO") contradict it; §10.5.3 ("The IOs holding the agreements a registration service uses are the relays it lists to members") and 03 §3.6 step 4 ("with its relays") omit SFUs and sequencers, which §6.6 and §14.4.1 say receive registrations. Use the §10.5.3 opening wording everywhere ("every IO holding a `ServiceAgreement` whose `serviceType` receives registrations (§10.5.1)"); restrict the "relays it lists" sentence to `relay` agreements. Full text: notes/review2/CON2-verified.md and notes/review2/CON2.md.
close_reason: 05:215 and 10:868 now limit registration to IOs whose serviceType receives registrations
